definitions.explanation: The state of being superior to or surpassing others in ability, status, or quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優越感|ゆうえつかん}→優越感：05996_yuuetsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧。
examples.english: To bask in a sense of superiority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術的|ぎじゅつてき}→技術的：05682_gijutsuteki⟧な{優越|ゆうえつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to maintain technological superiority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{優越感|ゆうえつかん}→優越感：05996_yuuetsukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧なさ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏返|うらがえ}し→裏返し：14032_uragaeshi⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: A sense of superiority over others is often actually a reflection of a lack of self-confidence.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{優|ゆう}→優：00431_yuu⟧ (superior, excellent) + {越|えつ} (surpass, exceed). Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{優越感|ゆうえつかん}→優越感：05996_yuuetsukan⟧ (sense/feeling of superiority), which is one of the most frequently used psychology-related terms in everyday Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{優越感|ゆうえつかん}→優越感：05996_yuuetsukan⟧: sense of superiority
- ⟦{優越感|ゆうえつかん}→優越感：05996_yuuetsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧: to revel in a sense of superiority
- ⟦{優越感|ゆうえつかん}→優越感：05996_yuuetsukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor a sense of superiority
- {優越|ゆうえつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧: a superior position
- {軍事的|ぐんじてき}{優越|ゆうえつ}: military superiority

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{劣等感|れっとうかん}→劣等感：05954_rettoukan⟧: inferiority complex — the opposite feeling
- ⟦{優位|ゆうい}→優位：11531_yuui⟧: advantage, dominance — focuses on position rather than feeling
- ⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧: to exceed, to surpass — a verb describing the action of being superior
